source.title: InteliLite 4 AMF 25 Datasheet
source.revision: Related HW ver 1.0; related SW ver 1.0.0
source.documentDate: 2021-04-29 (date of issue printed on the datasheet)
source.accessedVia: Public copy hosted by Penn CAT (dealer) — not the ComAp site. ComAp product page: https://comap-control.com/products/single-gen-set-controllers/intelilite
source.permittedUse: Facts summarised with attribution; the datasheet is copyright ComAp and is not reproduced.

entries.meaning: The controller's own supply range, not a battery charging limit.
entries.applicability: ComAp InteliLite 4 AMF 25, HW 1.0 / SW 1.0.0 datasheet. Controller supply only.

entries.meaning: D+ maximum output current 250 mA; the charging-fail threshold is adjustable (no default value is given in the datasheet).
entries.applicability: ComAp InteliLite 4 AMF 25 only. Output rating, not a charging threshold.

entries.meaning: Overspeed (ANSI 12), underspeed (14), undervoltage (27), aux battery undervoltage (27X), overvoltage, overfrequency (81O), underfrequency (81U), reverse power (32R), among others. The datasheet lists functions only; trip settings are not given.
entries.applicability: ComAp InteliLite 4 AMF 25 only. Lists functions; no trip values.

gaps: The InteliLite 4 AMF 25 Global Guide (setpoints, defaults, alarm texts) was not found as a public download in this session; setpoint values remain per controller configuration — NOT VERIFIED.
